notStaff.title: This is for staff
notStaff.body: {{email}} is not an administrator or a moderator. The back office is where staff run the shop; shopping and selling happen on the storefront.

setupRequired.title: Set up two-factor sign-in first
setupRequired.body: Staff sign in with a code from an authenticator app. Set it up from your account on the storefront, then sign in here again.
